payload.title: File:Foramen of Panizza-gl.svg
payload.description_html:
1st imaxe: Foramen of Panizza in a crocodile's heart.

2nd image: Blood circulation in normal breath. 3rd image: Blood circulation when the crocodile is underwater. VD = right ventricule. VE = Left ventricule. arco aórtico (sistémico) esquerdo = left aortic (systemic) arch. arco aórtico (sistémico) dereito = right aortic (systemic) arch. arteria pulmonar = pulmonary artery. forame de Panizza = foramen of Panizza. con respiración normal = in normal breath. mergullado (apnea) = submerged (apnea).

Based on: K. V. Kardong. Vertebrates. Comparative anatomy, function, evolution. Fig 12-37.
